service.description: Whether the user may see (view), work in (update: a member, or one who manages) or manage (manage) a project; a need not met is an error ("not available" when the user does not see it), except with need none, which only answers. isMember: the user holds a current role on it. A client contact (get#VisibleProjectInfo isClient) sees its client projects only and neither works in nor manages one (impl-projects.md P10). Closed is read only: canUpdate is false, and change requires both a manager and an open project. canManage retains role authority for reopening and late billing; it does not authorize manual project changes by itself.

parameter.name: canChange
parameter.description: A manager may change manual project settings while the project is not Closed.

parameter.name: sharesHours
parameter.description: For a client contact, whether the project shares its hours with the client (get#ClientProjectInfo shareHoursProjectIds); true for everyone else

service.description: The rows of Projects (design-projects.md §4 Projects): the projects the user sees, not templates, in one of the chips, narrowed by the find, sorted and paged, each decorated (decorate#ProjectRows), with the count of each chip. The chips: active (the default: Approved or In Progress), mine (open, the user holds a role), planned (In Planning), onHold, atRisk (open with the health At risk or Off track, or whose numbers warn: get#ProjectStats projectWarning or projectDanger, as Home's counter), completed (Complete), closed (Closed or Cancelled) and all. A status in the find takes the place of the chip's. Without subProjects only the top-level projects are rows (a program shows the count of its sub-projects); with subProjects Y each top-level row is followed by its sub-projects, indented, and its numbers sum theirs.

Projects as Projects, its board and Home's projects show them: the link, the client and the manager (the first ProjectManager, else Manager), the status and the health (label and color), the work items (open, overdue, done of total, as a percent), the next open milestone, the hours (actual of the hours budget, else of the estimate), with withMoney the client budget used (get#ProjectStats), a warning when the hours pass the budget or the numbers warn (hoursOver for the hours alone), the count of sub-projects, the last change. With sumSubProjects a program's items and hours sum those of its sub-projects in the list.

ProjectBulk (design-projects.md §4 Projects) on the selected projects (workEffortIds, a list or comma text), for those who manage each: manager (value the party, as the ProjectManager), hold (On Hold) and close (Closed, from Complete; a project not complete is completed first). Each project in its own transaction: one that fails is logged and counted with its reason, the others go on.

Moves a project along the Default flow (In Planning, Approved, In Progress, On Hold, Complete, Closed, Cancelled and the re-open moves; a project's own statusFlowId is its work items' flow), by one who manages it. The first move to In Progress sets the actual start, Complete the actual completion.

ProjectDetail's title row and numbers (design-projects.md §4 ProjectDetail): the project, its status stages, the health with the date of the latest update, the client and the manager, the number cards (open items, overdue, the next milestone, the hours of the budget or estimate; for managers the client budget used), the primary action by status (Approve, Begin, Post update, Resume, Close, Re-open), the unbilled amount for a manager who manages money (impl-projects.md P8a), and the other moves of the flow for the secondary menu, the modules on (WstModules), and whether it is a template or closed. visible false for a project the user does not see.

The boxes of ProjectOverview (design-projects.md §4 ProjectOverview): the latest status updates (the first the StatusBox, the rest its short list), the next three open milestones and releases with their items done of total, the work items by status (get#ProjectStats taskCountByStatusMap, each with its color and the Work items tab's link), the top-level items with their subtrees' roll-ups (get#WorkItemTree), the time and budget for those who manage (get#ProjectStats), the members, the linked repositories the user may view (org.moqui.git.GitServices find#GitRepositories with their clone URLs; none when the git hosting is not in the build) and the recent activity (get#ProjectActivity). Each box is read on its own: one that fails is logged and left empty.
PostUpdate (design-projects.md §4 ProjectOverview): a status update by one who manages the project (mantle.work.ProjectServices.post#ProjectUpdate).

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, need: 'change'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const percent = percentComplete == null || String(percentComplete).trim() === '' ? null : Number(String(percentComplete).trim()) if (percent != null && (!Number.isInteger(percent) || percent < 0 || percent > 100)) { ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('The percent complete is a whole number from 0 to 100')); return } ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.ProjectServices.post#ProjectUpdate').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, healthEnumId: healthEnumId, percentComplete: percent, body: body || '', clientVisible: clientVisible === 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return message = ec.l10n.localize('Status update posted')

service.description: ProjectTeam (design-projects.md §4): the members (the current WorkEffortParty rows in the project roles, not the client's, the vendor's or a team's), the teams (OrgTeam) and the client contacts (Customer, ClientManager, ClientBilling, CustomerBillTo, with their email and whether they have a user), and the roles a member may take (RoleGroupMember RgpProject less the client and vendor roles).
A person or team on a project in a role (a project role, OrgTeam for a team, or a client role for a client contact), by one who manages it (mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.add#WorkEffortParty).
Ends a party's role on a project now (thruDate; the history stays), by one who manages it.

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, need: 'change'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.WorkEffortServices.remove#WorkEffortParty').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, partyId: partyId, roleTypeId: roleTypeId}).call() if (!ec.message.hasError()) message = ec.l10n.localize('Taken off the project')

service.description: The values of ProjectSettings' boxes (design-projects.md §4 ProjectSettings): the project's fields (General), its modules (WstModules: backlog, requests, code, docs, time, money, client), its work item settings (the types offered, the work item flow on the project's statusFlowId, the estimate unit, several sprints, new items shared with the client, Fixes keywords, a request completing with its work), its client access settings, whether it is a template, and whether it may be deleted (no work items, time, invoices or commits). The settings come from get#ProjectSettings, so an organization default shows until the project sets its own.

actions.script: info = {} const access = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId}).call() || {} if (ec.message.hasError()) return const project = access.project const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ProjectSettings').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId}).call() || {} const settings = out.settings || {} const day = (value) => value == null ? '' : ec.l10n.format(value, 'yyyy-MM-dd') const cf = ec.entity.conditionFactory const client = Array.from(ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffortParty').condition('workEffortId', workEffortId).condition('roleTypeId', 'Customer') .condition(cf.makeConditionDate('fromDate', 'thruDate', null)).list())[0] const clientParty = client ? ec.entity.find('mantle.party.PartyDetail').condition('partyId', client.partyId).one() : null const program = project.parentWorkEffortId ? ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort').condition('workEffortId', project.parentWorkEffortId).one() : null const types = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#WorkItemTypes').parameters({rootWorkEffortId: workEffortId}).call() || {} const itemIds = Array.from(ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort').condition('rootWorkEffortId', workEffortId).selectField('workEffortId').limit(5000).list()) .map((row) => row.workEffortId).concat([workEffortId]) const hasItems = ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort').condition('rootWorkEffortId', workEffortId).condition('workEffortTypeEnumId', 'WetTask').count() > 0 const linked = (entityName) => ec.entity.find(entityName).condition('workEffortId', 'in', itemIds).count() > 0 const yn = (key) => settings[key] === 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N' info = {canManage: !!access.canManage, canChange: !!access.canChange, project: project, general: {workEffortId: workEffortId, workEffortName: project.workEffortName || '', purposeEnumId: project.purposeEnumId || '', priority: project.priority != null ? String(project.priority) : '5', visibilityEnumId: project.visibilityEnumId || '', colorName: project.colorName || '', clientPartyId: client?.partyId || '', clientName: clientParty ? (clientParty.organizationName || [clientParty.firstName, clientParty.lastName].filter((part) => part).join(' ')) : '', parentWorkEffortId: project.parentWorkEffortId || '', programName: program ? (program.workEffortName || program.workEffortId) + ' (' + program.workEffortId + ')' : '', estimatedStartDate: day(project.estimatedStartDate), estimatedCompletionDate: day(project.estimatedCompletionDate), description: project.description || ''}, modules: String(settings.WstModules || '').split(',').map((key) => key.trim()).filter((key) => key), workItems: {workItemTypes: Array.from(types.offeredList || []).map((row) => row.enumId), statusFlowId: project.statusFlowId || 'Default', estimateUnit: settings.WstEstimateUnit || 'hours', severalSprints: yn('WstSeveralSprints'), shareNewItems: yn('WstShareNewItems'), keywordComplete: settings.WstKeywordComplete === 'N' ? 'N' : 'Y', requestFromWork: settings.WstRequestFromWork === 'Y' || (settings.WstRequestFromWork == null && String(settings.WstModules || '').split(',').map((key) => key.trim()).includes('requests')) ? 'Y' : 'N'}, clientAccess: {clientSignIn: yn('WstClientSignIn'), shareRepositories: yn('WstShareRepositories')}, code: {branchPattern: settings.WstBranchPattern || '', mergeRequestMoves: yn('WstMergeRequestMoves')}, typeOptions: Array.from(types.typeList || []).map((row) => ({key: row.enumId, text: row.label})), isTemplate: project.isTemplate === 'Y', settingSources: out.settingSources || {}, canDelete: project.statusId !== 'WeClosed' && !hasItems && !linked('mantle.work.time.TimeEntry') && !linked('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffortInvoice') && !linked('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffortGitCommit')}

service.description: ProjectSettings' General box: the project's name, purpose, priority, visibility, client (the Customer role), program (a project that is not this one or under it), dates and description (mantle.work.ProjectServices update#Project), by one who manages it.

ProjectSettings' Modules, Work items and Client access boxes, by one who manages the project: modules (a list or comma text of backlog, requests, code, docs, time, money, client) as WstModules; workItemTypes as WstWorkItemTypes, in their order; the work item flow (Default or WorkEffortDevelopment) on the project's statusFlowId; estimateUnit (hours or points), severalSprints, shareNewItems, keywordComplete, requestFromWork, clientSignIn, shareRepositories and mergeRequestMoves (Y or N) as their WorkEffortSettings; branchPattern as WstBranchPattern (empty: the organization's). Only the values given change.

parameter.name: box
parameter.description: modules, workItems or clientAccess: an empty modules or types list counts only for its box

service.description: TemplateBox's "this project is a template" (WorkEffort isTemplate), by one who manages it: a template leaves the project lists and is offered in NewProject and Settings/Templates.

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#ProjectAccess').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, need: 'change'}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const flag = isTemplate === 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N' ec.service.sync().name('update#mantle.work.effort.WorkEffort').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, isTemplate: flag}).call() if (!ec.message.hasError()) message = flag === 'Y' ? ec.l10n.localize('This project is now a template') : ec.l10n.localize('This project is no longer a template')

service.description: TemplateBox's and Settings/Templates' "save as template": a copy of the project kept as a template (mantle.work.ProjectServices.create#ProjectTemplate), with a key and a name; or with no project a blank template. For the Projects managers.
CloseProject's Delete: a project with no work items, time, invoices or commits linked, with its members, settings, status updates and plan items, by one who manages it.

NewProject's Start step and QuickCreate's QuickProject (design-projects.md §4 NewProject ProjectStart, §3 QuickProject): a project with a key (one to eight letters or digits, upper case, not taken), a name, a purpose (Client Project when a client is given and no purpose), a client (Customer), a manager (ProjectManager; the user by default), dates, a visibility (General, all internal users, by default, impl-projects.md F10; or Work group, members only), a program and a description, owned by the user's internal organization (also its Vendor); from a template (clone#Project with its tree, members and settings; the dates of the copy are cleared) when one is given. The project starts In Planning. For Projects managers (BOSS_PROJECT_MANAGER) and ADMIN only (impl-projects.md F8).

parameter.name: workEffortId
parameter.description: The key; when empty, suggested from the name (the first letters of its words, or the start of a one-word name, with a digit when taken)

parameter.name: cloneFromWorkEffortId
parameter.description: ProjectDetail's Clone: a copy of a project the user sees, as from a template

service.description: NewProject's Modules and code step (design-projects.md §4 ProjectModulesStep): the modules, the estimate unit and the work item flow (save#ProjectSettingValues); a repository (repositoryChoice none, local or db: a new one, mantle.work.GitServices.create#ProjectRepository with repositoryId, by default the key in lower case; link: an existing one the user may view, add#ProjectRepository); documentation (docsChoice none, db: a space on database files, or repository: a space in the repository made or linked here, else the project's first, at docs/; mantle.work.ProjectServices.create#ProjectDocsSpace, named in WstDocsWikiSpace). By one who manages the project; a repository already linked or a space already set is left as it is.

NewProject's Money step (design-projects.md §4 ProjectMoneyStep): the billing basis (WstBillingBasis: TimeAndMaterials, FixedPrice, Milestones or NotBilled), the hours budget (totalTimeAllowed) and the client budget (totalClientCostAllowed, in costUomId), by one who manages the project. An empty budget clears it.

The rates scoped to a project (RateAmount with its workEffortId, current and coming), for those who manage it: purpose, the person, work type or position class, the amount and the dates. The worker pay rate of a person who is an employee is the employee's pay: its amount only with PAYROLL_VIEW (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess).

service.description: A rate scoped to a project (mantle.humanres.RateServices.create#RateAmount with the project's workEffortId, from now): client billing (RaprClient) or worker pay (RaprVendor), for a person, a work type or a position class, or everyone on the project; by one who manages it. A worker pay rate of a person who is an employee is the employee's pay: only with PAYROLL_EDIT (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess).
Ends a project's rate now (thruDate), by one who manages the project; a worker pay rate of a person who is an employee only with PAYROLL_EDIT (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess).

Projects Home (design-projects.md §3 Home) for the team and the managers: the counters (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ProjectHomeCounts, the managers' with managers), my next work items (the open items assigned to me, by due date then priority, ten; WorkItemServices find#WorkItems list mine), what changed lately in my projects (get#ProjectActivity of up to six of them, merged, ten), and my projects (the managers' those they manage, else those they are on; decorated, twelve). firstRun when the user sees no project. Each part stands alone: one that fails is logged and left empty. reviewList: the merge requests waiting for the user's review (five, last updated first; org.moqui.git.GitReviewServices.find#MergeRequests waitingForUserId, decorated by ironstone.projects.CodeServices.decorate#MergeRequestRows), with hosting false when the build has no git hosting. timer: the user's running timer, and approvalList: the submitted weeks the user approves (ironstone.projects.TimeServices.get#HomeTime; impl-projects.md P6a), then the requested allocations the user decides (ironstone.projects.ResourceServices.get#HomeAllocations; impl-projects.md P7). The charts (P9) come with their phase.
The organization whose Projects settings the user sees and changes: the active organization, else the first of the user's organizations (get#VisibleProjectInfo orgIds).
A Projects settings change is for the Projects managers and ADMIN; others get an error.

actions.script: if (!ec.user.isInGroup('BOSS_PROJECT_MANAGER') && !ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN')) ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Only project managers change the Projects settings'))

service.description: The work item types (design-projects.md §12 WorkItemTypes): the purposes a work item may take (WorkEffortPurpose under WetTask, not To Do, Communication or Placeholder, and Support, Research, Development and Deployment), each with its label, its icon (the organization's choice, else the standard one) and whether it is offered, with its place. The offered types are the project's WstWorkItemTypes when rootWorkEffortId is given (its own, else the organization's), else the organization's ProjWorkItemTypes offered; with no setting Task, Bug Fix, New Feature, Feature Enhancement, Document and Support. offeredList is the offered types in order.

The organization's work item types (PartySetting ProjWorkItemTypes, a JSON object: offered, the types in order as a comma list; icons, the icon chosen for a type when it is not the standard one). offered a list or comma text; icons a map of enumId to a Material Symbols name. For the Projects managers.

WorkItemTypes' NewType: a type of the organization's own, an Enumeration of WorkEffortPurpose under WetTask (id WepOrg and a number) with its label, offered at the end with its icon. For the Projects managers.

Workflows (design-projects.md §12): the flows of projects and work items (Default and WorkEffortDevelopment, and any other flow of WorkEffort statuses) with the projects using each as their work item flow; the transitions of one flow between WorkEffort statuses (from, to, name); and the WorkEffort statuses with their sequence and color (StatusItem statusColor, else the guessed one).
Adds or renames a move of a flow between WorkEffort statuses (StatusFlowTransition), or with remove Y takes it out. For the Projects managers.
A WorkEffort status's description, sequence or color (statusColor: grey-7, primary, warning, positive, negative or info; empty for the guessed one). For the Projects managers.
Labels (design-projects.md §12): the organization's labels (WorkEffortCategory WcatLabel, owned by it or by no one) by name, each with its color and the count of work items that have it.

actions.script: labelList = [] organizationPartyId = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.ProjectServices.get#SettingsOrganization').call()?.organizationPartyId || null const cf = ec.entity.conditionFactory const owners = [cf.makeCondition('ownerPartyId', 'is-null', null)].concat(organizationPartyId ? [cf.makeCondition('ownerPartyId', 'equals', organizationPartyId)] : []) for (const row of ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffortCategory').condition('categoryTypeEnumId', 'WcatLabel').condition(cf.makeCondition(owners, 'or')) .orderBy('description').limit(500).list()) labelList.push({workEffortCategoryId: row.workEffortCategoryId, description: row.description || row.workEffortCategoryId, colorName: row.colorName || 'grey', itemCount: ec.entity.find('mantle.work.effort.WorkEffortCategoryAppl').condition('workEffortCategoryId', row.workEffortCategoryId).count()})

service.description: The Labels page's changes, for the Projects managers, on the organization's labels: action create (description, colorName), update (workEffortCategoryId, description, colorName), delete (workEffortCategoryId) or merge (fromCategoryId into intoCategoryId), through the mantle.work.TaskServices label services.

The Docs tab's data for a project the user sees: the documentation space (wikiSpaceId, its name, its storage as text, whether the user may view and change it), whether the Docs module is on, whether the user may set it up (one who manages the project) and the project's repositories the user may update (for a space in a repository), and the linked pages of other spaces the user may view (title, space, link) with whether the user may link and unlink (the team).
Set up documentation: the project's documentation space (mantle.work.ProjectServices.create#ProjectDocsSpace), storage repository (in repositoryId, at docs/) or db, by one who manages the project.

service.description: Link page: a page of another space the user may view (wikiPageId) linked to the project (WikiPageWorkEffort), by the project's team; unlink removes the link.
